## 9. Privacy, security and data

### 9.1 Who is responsible

Kabsi is operated by Hussein Slim, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, who is the seller and the data controller. The privacy page and the terms read the seller from the one `LEGAL_SELLER` constant and say Kabsi is not partnered with Google. Contact: hello@kabsi.co. The site gives a city only, never a street address. The footer of every public page says: "Google and Google Business Profile are trademarks of Google LLC. Kabsi is independent and not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Google."

### 9.2 What Kabsi collects

- **Owners:** email and extra alert addresses; business name, address, country, time zone and Google identifiers; About your business facts; Google reviews (public name, rating, text, dates), drafts and replies; posts, photos, special hours; listing details for Google Protection; plan and payments (plan, amount and date); the authorisation you gave; a log of emails sent; a record of approvals and changes (who did what and when, from the dashboard or an email link, the country of the connection and the browser, never the IP address and never review text).
- **People who tap a card or open a link:** code, time, country, Android or iPhone, chip or QR, and a crawler flag. Never who they are or their IP address.
- **Free tool users:** the search text goes to Google's Places API; a one-way salted hash of the IP is kept one hour to stop abuse.
- **Free Google Profile Check users:** the search text goes to Google's Places API; what Google shows publicly about the business they pick is kept up to 24 hours; a one-way salted hash of the IP is kept one day to enforce 3 checks a day. If they ask for the check by email: the address, the business's Google Place ID, whether they ticked the tips box, the words next to it, the page and the time (proof of their choice).
- **People who chat with Nora (the assistant):** their messages, the page they asked from, browser time zone and language, device type, the site that sent them, the country from the network (never the IP address), and any contact details they choose to give. Each chat is labelled (topic, intent, country) and a short report goes to the Kabsi team so a person can follow up. News emails only with a yes.
- **People who wrote to Kabsi's earlier WhatsApp number (before 22 Oct 2026):** they can ask for that chat to be deleted by emailing hello@kabsi.co (see section 9.5b). Kabsi does not copy chats into its own database.
- **Forms:** what you enter. **Visitors:** anonymous statistics and error reports.

### 9.3 How it's used

To provide Kabsi, to process public reviews so you can answer them, to keep Kabsi secure, and to keep payment records as the law requires. Kabsi doesn't sell or rent personal data, doesn't use it for advertising, doesn't send marketing emails without asking first, and never uses Google data to train AI models.

### 9.4 AI

Review text and business facts go to Anthropic's API for drafts and checks (photos are checked by Kabsi's own code and are not sent to an AI model); Anthropic doesn't train on this data. The owner approves every reply, post, photo and listing change. AI drafts can be wrong, so read each one; you're responsible for what you approve.

### 9.5 Processors and regions

Supabase (database, sign-in, storage; Frankfurt, Germany), Cloudflare (go.kabsi.co links and the bot check on forms), Vercel (hosting), Resend (email; EU, Ireland), Anthropic (drafts), Google (Business Profile and Places APIs), Sentry (error reports; EU, without IPs or review content), PostHog (anonymous statistics; United States), Zoho (the hello@kabsi.co mailbox). Kapso and Meta are listed again when Kabsi has a WhatsApp number. Calendly and Creem are added to the list on the privacy page when they go live.

Some providers are outside the United Arab Emirates and the EU. They process data only on Kabsi's instructions and under their data protection terms, including standard contractual clauses where required.

### 9.5b WhatsApp: privacy (privacy page section 14, terms section 16)

How it works today: Kabsi has no WhatsApp number at the moment (the earlier number was retired on 22 Oct 2026). People write to hello@kabsi.co, and a person at Kabsi reads and answers it; it is not an automatic bot. Nothing is approved, published or changed over WhatsApp. Approvals happen only on kabsi.co. Kabsi never asks for a Google password or a code Google sends, by email, on WhatsApp or anywhere else. People should not send review text, passwords or codes.

What is sent: nothing goes over WhatsApp today. Kabsi puts no Google data and no review text into WhatsApp, and the assistant (Nora) reads no WhatsApp messages.

Who handles it: when Kabsi has a WhatsApp number again, Kapso (the inbox and the messaging service) and Meta (runs WhatsApp and carries the messages) are its processors, and the privacy page and terms name them before it starts. Kabsi does not use WhatsApp for marketing messages.

How long it is kept: if someone wrote to Kabsi's earlier WhatsApp number before 22 Oct 2026, no automatic deletion date was set for that chat; they can ask for it to be deleted by emailing hello@kabsi.co from their account address, and Kabsi tells them when it is done. The chat stays on the person's own phone until they delete it there.

Not live yet (P0.8-03; say "not available yet", never give a date): owner alerts and approvals on WhatsApp. When they come: alerts only after the owner opts in (the time, the phone number and the wording shown are recorded); a review alert carries the business, the star rating, the reviewer's first name, the review text up to 300 characters and the draft, after that opt-in; the owner can reply STOP (or a similar word such as UNSUBSCRIBE) at any time and Kabsi stops at once and records it. The privacy page and terms are updated, and account holders emailed, before any of it is switched on.

Likely questions and the answers: "Do you have a WhatsApp number?" Not at the moment; write to hello@kabsi.co and a person answers, not a bot. "Do you ask for my Google password or code on WhatsApp?" Never, on WhatsApp or anywhere else. "Can I approve a reply or post on WhatsApp?" Not yet; approve on kabsi.co. "Will Kabsi send me alerts on WhatsApp?" Not yet; email is the only alert channel today, and WhatsApp alerts will need the owner's opt-in and can be stopped with STOP. "How do I delete a chat I had with your old WhatsApp number?" Email hello@kabsi.co; there is no automatic deletion date, so Kabsi deletes it when asked.

### 9.6 Cookies

Sign-in storage, the last business you opened (in your browser), and the visitor's privacy choice. A small Kabsi privacy banner (no outside consent tool) asks once, by country: in the EU and EEA (and when the country is unknown) statistics and advertising both wait for a yes; in the UK, the UAE and Saudi Arabia statistics run in totals only with an opt-out and advertising waits for a yes; everywhere else both are on with notice and an opt-out. Until the visitor chooses, PostHog counts visits without cookies or any identifier; after a yes it keeps an anonymous identifier and may record screens on public pages (never inside the app); after a no it stops. Each choice is stored as proof (anonymous id, the signed-in user if any, country and rule, the exact wording and its version, page, time; no IP, email or name). "Privacy choices" at the foot of every page and on /privacy reopens it. The site works the same whatever the visitor picks. No advertising cookies or cross-site tracking today; the Meta Pixel is [COMING] after launch and can load only where the choice allows it. The banner is in English only at launch. Where a sign-up came from: the browser keeps the first and last campaign (utm fields), the first page and the referring site, and Kabsi saves them with the account at sign-up, on the server; a Meta click id (fbclid, fbc) only where the privacy choice allows advertising. A referral link (via=CODE) sets a first-party cookie, kabsi_via, for 60 days, the newest referral wins, and the code is saved with the account and the business at sign-up (disclosed on /privacy); Kabsi Partners itself is [COMING] after launch. Usage events go to PostHog through kabsi.co (kabsi.co/ingest) with ids, counts and channels only; access, drafts, approvals, publishing, decisions, payments and new accounts are sent by Kabsi's servers from its own records, never from the browser; the demo workspace and kabsi.co test accounts send nothing. No autocapture; no screen recording inside the app.

### 9.6b Website protection

kabsi.co sends HSTS, nosniff, a strict referrer policy and a permissions policy that turns off camera, microphone and location for the pages (choosing a photo from the phone still works); a content security policy runs in report-only mode, with reports to Kabsi's error tracker, and is enforced only after 14 clean days. App pages, email action pages and API answers are never cached. A Cloudflare Turnstile check, verified on the server, protects sign-up and login by email code, both free tools (the Profile Check and the review link and QR code), the contact form and the start of a chat with Nora for a visitor who is not signed in; the free tools also allow at most 10 requests a minute from one network. Vercel's bot protection watches kabsi.co. Likely question: "Why do I see a check box?" It is Cloudflare's check that you are a person; it does not track you.

### 9.7 Retention

The privacy page shows the 11 rows of the retention table (`retention_policies`, K-40) in plain words from `src/lib/retention.ts`; a test holds the page equal to the table. The table below adds the rows that follow other rules.

| Data | Kept |
|---|---|
| Business data | While you use Kabsi; deleted 7 days after a deletion request |
| Review text and reviewer names | At most 30 days after Google last sent them |
| Rating history, quotes in reports sent before 4 October 2026 (newer reports carry none), decided Google Protection before/after values | 30 days |
| Other Google profile details Kabsi reads (category and area, Google's answer to a change Kabsi sent) | 30 days |
| Review ids, star ratings, dates, reply state and your own replies | While you use Kabsi |
| Your own facts and approved values (About your business, the details you confirmed or told Google Protection to keep, approved posts and hours; earlier versions are kept as a history) | While you use Kabsi; deleted with the business. Deleting a fact in About your business removes it and its earlier versions at once |
| Google's values of your details that you have not confirmed, and Google's side of a Google Protection change | 30 days after Kabsi read them; a change still waiting for your answer keeps them until it is answered or closed |
| Photos you upload | The file as you sent it and Kabsi's cleaned copy are deleted 30 days after the photo is on Google, or soon after you skip it or Kabsi refuses the file; it then leaves the Photos list (it stays on Google). A video is deleted 30 days after it arrives |
| Google data after access is removed | Deleted after 30 days unless access returns |
| Assistant chats | 12 months after the last message |
| Contact details given to the assistant | Until you ask us to remove them |
| Email log | 12 months |
| Record of approvals and changes | 24 months; the details of a deleted business are blanked, who did what and when stays |
| WhatsApp chats with Kabsi's earlier number (before 22 Oct 2026) | No automatic deletion date was set; deleted when the person asks at hello@kabsi.co |
| Internal job logs | 90 days |
| Email action links | Expire after 72 hours, removed 30 days later |
| Payment records | As long as tax and accounting law requires, unlinked from the business when it's deleted |
| Review link and QR code opens | Kept without personal data, for counts |
| Free tool abuse limits | 1 hour |
| Google's public details for a business checked in the free Profile Check | 24 hours |
| Email request for the free Profile Check, with the tips choice | Until you ask us to remove it |

### 9.8 Your rights and deleting data

- You can ask to see, correct, delete, get a copy of, or object to the use of your data. Most of it works in the app; otherwise email hello@kabsi.co from your account address, and Kabsi replies within 30 days. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.
- **Delete a business:** Settings, Emails page, **Delete this business from Kabsi**, type the business name, **Delete in 7 days**. You get an email notice ("<Business>: leaves Kabsi on <date> unless you cancel"). Until the date, everything keeps working and you can tap **Cancel deletion**. Then Kabsi deletes reviews, drafts, posts, photos, reports and settings, deletes review links, unlinks NFC cards (they stop opening your page), and emails a confirmation. Payment records are kept where the law requires.
- Also remove the Kabsi Clients group (ID 5481006796) from People and access. To delete your login too, or if you can't sign in, email hello@kabsi.co.
- A reviewer asking about their review: hand off.

### 9.8b About page and founder note

The About page says who runs Kabsi (Hussein Slim, from Dubai, who is also the seller and the person responsible for data; Kabsi serves businesses in any country), why Kabsi exists, the meaning of the name, how to reach a person (hello@kabsi.co, or the free setup call), and that Kabsi is independent and not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Google. The homepage carries a short founder note signed Hussein Slim, with Kabsi's mark and no photo. There are no customer quotes, logos or counts on these pages; Kabsi has no published case study yet. The W4 video has its place on About and shows nothing until it exists.

### 9.9 Security

The security page opens with three facts (no password, ever; access you can remove; nothing posted without you), then says: what a Manager can do; that every reply, post, photo and change waits for your tap; that Kabsi gives no one else, partners included, a way to read or write your Google data; how to disconnect (Settings, **Disconnect Kabsi from Google**, or remove Kabsi Clients on Google; team removal within 7 business days if Google refuses); the written notice within 48 hours of any access change; sign-in by email code with no passwords; that Kabsi never asks for a Google password or code and stores no Google token of yours; email links (once, 72 hours, owner only); data in Frankfurt; that Kabsi's own Google account is protected with Google's Advanced Protection Program; Google data never sold, used for ads or used to train AI, read by people at Kabsi only with consent, for security or as the law requires.

Sign-in by one-time email code, no passwords. Each business's data is separated at the database level; only its members, and Kabsi staff when helping, can read it. Email action links work once, expire after 72 hours, belong to the person they were sent to, are stored only as a hash and never act on opening. Profile changes, hours and reviews that need care also need that person signed in. Kabsi's Google access stays on Kabsi's servers. Data is encrypted in transit. Kabsi is for businesses and not meant for anyone under 18.

## 10. Troubleshooting

**I didn't get my login code.**
Check spam, check the address, tap **Resend code**. Still stuck: hand off.

**I can't find "People and access" on my Google profile.**
Kabsi works with a verified profile that you own or manage. The listing may need to be verified or claimed on Google first, and only owners can add people. You can finish the other setup steps now.

**I sent the invite but it still says "Waiting for your invite".**
**[TIME-SENSITIVE]** While Kabsi is in test mode (2.2), real businesses stay at "Waiting for Google access" until the team accepts the invitation (early access, within one working day) or Kabsi connects to Google. Check that you invited group ID 5481006796 exactly, with the Manager role, on the right business, and that you did not invite the email address hello@kabsi.co.

**I got "Kabsi can't reach {business} on Google".**
Google stopped letting Kabsi read the reviews, usually because the Kabsi group was removed as a Manager. Add it again as a Manager under People and access. Kabsi reconnects by itself within a few minutes. Until then no replies are drafted and nothing is posted. If you removed Kabsi on purpose, do nothing.

**My business isn't found in the search.**
Use the exact Google Maps name plus city, or name plus street. It must have a Google Business Profile on Maps.

**It says "Not ready: Kabsi couldn't safely verify this draft".**
The draft failed a check twice, for example it named someone who is not in your facts, gave a price or opening time you never gave, or read like a reply you already posted. Kabsi shows the draft with the problems listed, never as ready. Tap **Fix it myself** to start from it, write your own reply, ask for changes, or tap Skip.

**The email link says it has expired or was already used.**
Links work once and last 72 hours (3 days). Open Kabsi and use Reviews, Needs reply. Tapping Approve a second time, or opening the link again, does nothing new: the page shows what already happened.

**The email page asks me to sign in.**
For a high-risk review, a change to your opening hours and any change to your profile details, the page asks the person the email was sent to to sign in with their email code first, then brings them back to the same page. Normal review replies and skips work from the link alone. If someone else is signed in on that phone or computer, the page says the link was sent to someone else: sign out, then sign in with the address the email went to.

**Can I undo an approval from the email page?**
Yes, on the email page and in the app. After you tap Approve, the screen shows "Publishing in 10 seconds" with Undo. Undo inside the 10 seconds and nothing is sent to Google; the reply goes back to Needs reply. After the 10 seconds it says "Approved. On its way to Google." and it is too late to undo.

**I posted but the reply isn't on Google.**
After you approve, Kabsi waits 10 seconds, then sends the reply to Google, usually within a minute or two. Google checks every reply before it appears, usually within 10 minutes, sometimes longer. Reviews shows "Google is checking your reply" while it waits. Kabsi checks again after 10 minutes and then less often, and never posts the same reply twice. If Google does not accept the reply, the review comes back to Needs reply with the reason, so you can edit it and approve again. If Google still does not show it after 7 days, Kabsi treats it the same way. Approving the same reply twice (for example in the app and from the email) sends it once. **[TIME-SENSITIVE]** In test mode nothing is sent to Google at all.

**I approved a post, photo, holiday hours or "Keep my information" and it isn't on Google yet.**
Posts, photos, special hours and putting a detail back with Google Protection go to Google the same way as replies: Kabsi waits 10 seconds after you approve, then sends it, usually within a minute or two. Until then the post or photo shows "Sending to Google", the hours show "Sending" and the change shows "Your information is on its way to Google". Kabsi then reads your profile again and marks it "Your information is back on Google" once Google shows it and no longer lists it as its own change. Approving twice (two taps, two tabs, the app and the email) sends it once. If Google does not answer, Kabsi checks your profile instead of sending again. A post Google is still checking shows once Google allows it. If Google refuses it or still does not show it after 7 days, it shows "Not posted", "Couldn't post", "Not saved" or "Google did not take your information", and nothing is sent twice. **[TIME-SENSITIVE]** In test mode nothing is sent to Google at all.

**I'm not getting review emails.**
Check spam, and Settings, Emails: emails may be paused (**Turn emails back on**), or the daily time and time zone may be off. Reviews that need extra care arrive at once; other reviews arrive at once while you are open and in the daily email after hours, and nothing is emailed between 22:00 and 08:00. Reviews always appear in the app too, and in the bell on Home.

**My staff member gets emails but can't post.**
That's by design. Extra addresses (up to 3) see new reviews only. To let someone help in the app, invite them in Settings, Team: as a manager they can approve what you allow; as staff they can add photos and share the review link.

**Kabsi didn't prepare a post this month.**
Kabsi prepares a post only from something true: a fact you confirmed in About your business in the last 90 days, or a photo you approved in the last 30. Without one it asks "Anything new this month? A dish, a service, an event?" instead. A draft that fails a check never reaches you. Kabsi's posts also need the switch on and an active business.

**There is no Suggest phrases button.** Search phrases come back with Kabsi writing posts for you, once Kabsi's AI credit is on. Write your post in your own words meanwhile.

**My photo won't upload.** Use JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC up to 20 MB, up to 20 at a time. A file that is not really a photo, or a moving image, is refused with the reason on the Photos screen.

**Home says "Google check is late" in amber.** Kabsi has not managed to read the Google profile for more than 6 hours. The team is alerted when checks keep failing. If you removed the Kabsi group from People and access, add it again as a Manager.

**My card opens "This Kabsi card isn't set up yet".**
The card isn't linked yet. Tap through and sign in to link it, or add its code under Get reviews, **Add a Kabsi card**.

**My card opens "This review link isn't active".**
It was switched off. Switch it on under Get reviews. If the business was deleted, the card was unlinked.

**My card doesn't react when tapped.**
NFC doesn't work through metal, so don't mount it on metal. The QR code works as a backup. Otherwise hand off.

**My self-written NFC tag doesn't work.**
Rewrite it with the exact link from **Copy review link**, as a URL / URI record. Check the link is switched on in Get reviews. If the tag was locked with a wrong link, it can't be fixed: use a new tag. Tags you wrote yourself can't be added with **Add a Kabsi card**; their opens show under the review link.

**My plan shows "Paid" but hasn't started.**
Correct: a plan starts when Google access works (section 4.3).

**Google Protection says "Google did not take your information".**
Google didn't accept the change, or still did not show your version 7 days later. Update the detail on your Google profile directly, or hand off.

**Google Protection says "Kabsi's team is asking Google support".**
Google changed the same detail again after Kabsi put your approved value back twice in 30 days. Kabsi does not send it a third time; a person on the Kabsi team contacts Google Business Profile support for you.

---

## 11. FAQ

### About Kabsi

**What is Kabsi?**
Kabsi looks after your business on Google: a reply is drafted for every new review in the reviewer's language, your hours and details are kept right, and fresh posts are prepared. It also shows what needs attention on your profile and watches your listing for changes you did not make (Google Protection). Nothing is posted or changed until you approve it.

**Who is Kabsi for?**
Any local business with a verified Google Business Profile that meets customers in person or travels to them, in any country: cafés, restaurants, clinics, salons, garages, hotels, shops, florists, plumbers, cleaners and more. Not online-only businesses, rental or for-sale properties, or PO boxes and virtual offices used as an address (section 2.1c).

**Is Kabsi part of Google?**
No. Kabsi is independent and not affiliated with Google. It works through Google's official Business Profile access, like a staff member you add as a Manager.

**How is this different from Gemini in Business Profile?**
Gemini is Google's free assistant for one verified profile that you open and ask. Kabsi comes to you with a reply already prepared, tells you when Google changes your listing, writes only from facts you confirmed, and has a person behind it. Source: https://support.google.com/business/answer/17142585

**Which businesses can use Kabsi?**
Any business with a verified Google Business Profile that you own or manage. Setup asks first. If your profile isn't verified yet, or someone else manages it, setup shows what to do on Google, and you can come back.

**Can I book a setup call?**
Yes. The team offers a free 20-minute setup call, Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm Beirut time. Book it at kabsi.co/setup-call, or email hello@kabsi.co and we'll arrange a time. Staff never sign in to your Google account: you send the invitation yourself.

**How does Kabsi protect my Google profile?**
You invite the Kabsi Clients group (ID 5481006796) as a Manager, not as an owner, and you can remove it at any time from People and access. Kabsi only accepts an invitation that matches a business you have set up and only for the Manager role. Kabsi's Google account uses Google's Advanced Protection. Nothing is written to Google without your approval, and each approval is recorded with the exact text, who approved it, when, and whether it came from the dashboard or an email link.

**Where is Kabsi based?**
Kabsi is operated by Hussein Slim, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, and serves businesses in any country.

**Who runs Kabsi?**
Kabsi is run by Hussein Slim, from Dubai. A person answers at hello@kabsi.co.

**Do I need to install anything?**
No. Kabsi works from your email and your phone's web browser.

**Is Kabsi connected to Google right now?**
[TIME-SENSITIVE] Not through Google's API yet. Kabsi's API access is under Google's review, so Kabsi runs in test mode. You can sign up and set up now. In early access a person on our team does the Google steps by hand, within one working day, and you still approve every word. Your trial or plan starts when access works.

**When will Kabsi be live on Google?**
We're waiting on Google's review and can't give a date. We'll email you when your business is connected.

**Is there a demo?**
Yes. The home page has an interactive example inbox in English, Spanish, Arabic and French, labelled "Example". Kabsi's product videos are recorded in a demo workspace with two invented businesses, Harbour Lane Coffee and Juniper Hair Studio; every screen there carries a "Demo data" tag, and none of their reviews, names or numbers are real.

### How it works

**Does Kabsi post replies by itself?**
No. Kabsi drafts a reply and emails it to you. Nothing goes on your Google profile until you tap Approve reply, and you see the exact text first.

**What does Kabsi need from me?**
Add the Kabsi group ID 5481006796 as a Manager on your Google Business Profile, then tell Kabsi a few facts in About your business. Drafts only use the facts you give.

**How long does setup take?**
A few minutes: find your business, add the Kabsi group ID 5481006796 as a Manager, fill in About your business, choose a plan.

**How fast do new reviews reach me?**
Kabsi checks every few minutes. Reviews of 3 stars or less, and any review Kabsi marks medium or high risk, are emailed right away; other reviews are emailed at once while your business is open and come together in the daily email, at the hour you choose, outside your opening hours. Nothing is emailed between 22:00 and 08:00; it waits until 08:00.

**Can I reply from my phone?**
Yes. Tap Approve reply, Edit or Skip in the email, confirm on the page that opens, or use the app in your phone's browser. A high-risk review asks you to sign in on that page first.

**Can I edit a draft before posting?**
Yes. Change anything you like. Kabsi publishes exactly the text you approve.

**Can I ask Kabsi to rewrite a draft?**
Yes. Tap Other options, then choose Shorter, More formal, Warmer, Say sorry more clearly or Regenerate, or type what to change and tap New version. Up to 3 new versions per review per day.

**What happens with hard reviews?**
Kabsi gives every review one of three risk levels. Rules in code look first, then a small AI model, and the higher level wins.
- Low (normal praise or mild feedback): a draft as usual.
- Medium (a complaint, a refund request, a complaint about staff, something said about your business that may be wrong, any rating of 1 to 3, and every review of a medical, dental, legal or financial business): a careful draft, with the issue shown above it, for example "They mention a refund. Kabsi didn't promise one."
- High (a legal threat, discrimination, illness, injury, an allergy or another safety problem, a threat, harassment, privacy or personal data, a regulator or an inspection, an accusation of a crime): no draft. The review is marked "This review needs a little more care" with a short checklist, and the email has the checklist and no approve button. If you want, Kabsi writes a short, neutral holding reply, only when you ask for it. You can also write your own, choose "I'll reply myself" or skip it.

**Does Kabsi treat clinics, law firms and financial businesses differently?**
Yes. For a health, dental, legal or financial business (from your Google category), every review is at least medium risk, and a reply never says the reviewer was a patient or client and never mentions a visit, an appointment or a treatment. Kabsi checks each draft for this before you see it.

**What does "I'll reply myself" do?**
It marks the review "You replied yourself", and Kabsi won't post anything for it. It is under Other options, next to Skip ("You chose not to reply").

**What about my old reviews?**
When Kabsi first reads your reviews, it drafts replies for the most recent reviews without a reply: up to 10 during the free trial (the others wait for your plan) and up to 20 on a paid plan. Home then says "We found 23 unanswered reviews. Replies are ready." For the low-risk ones you can see the full list and approve them together: you approve exactly the replies you saw, and Kabsi sends them at most 5 a minute, with a progress line ("14 of 23 published"). Reviews that need a look you read one by one, and reviews that need more care get no draft. Nothing is posted until you approve it. [TIME-SENSITIVE] Drafting every old review on a paid plan is built but switched on with the live Google switch.

**Does Kabsi reply to reviews with no text?**
Yes. It drafts a short thank-you for the rating, which you approve like any other.

**Can other people get the review emails?**
Yes. Add up to 3 extra addresses in Settings, Emails. They see new reviews, but only you can post.

**Can I pause emails while on holiday?**
Yes. Settings, Emails, Pause for 7 days. Reviews still arrive in your Kabsi inbox.

**What is the weekly report?**
Every Monday at 08:00 local time: how many things Kabsi took care of that week, your public Google rating and change, new reviews, how many got a reply, how often your review link or QR code was opened, what your profile did for customers that week, what needs you, and an estimate of the time Kabsi saved you (5 minutes a reply, 15 an update, 10 a batch of photos, 10 a profile check that found something; never money). Facts only, with no quotes from customers' reviews.

### Replies and AI

**Who writes the replies?**
Kabsi's AI drafts them from your facts. You read, edit and approve each one.

**Is there a limit on drafts?**
Yes, a daily one, so a flood of reviews or a very long review can't run up costs. Each business can get up to 60 drafts a day (replies and posts together). If you reach it, Kabsi says "Kabsi has written as many drafts as it can for this business today. New drafts start again tomorrow." Reviews that arrive meanwhile wait and are drafted the next day. Very long reviews are read up to Google's 4,096-character length.

**Will a reply include my phone number, email or website?**
No. Google can reject replies that contain phone numbers, emails, links, social media handles or hashtags, so Kabsi's drafts never include them, and a draft that does is stopped before you see it as ready. Prices appear only if you wrote them in About your business. An unhappy customer is asked to get in touch through the details on your profile. Posts follow the same rule: a post's button carries the link or the call.

**What if the AI makes a mistake?**
You see the exact text before anything is posted and can edit or skip it. Drafts use only your facts and pass a safety check first.

**Does Kabsi learn from my edits?**
Only when you say so. When you change a draft the same way three times (for example making it shorter), Kabsi asks once "Save this as a rule?". When you add a fact to a reply (for example "We now open on Sundays"), it asks once "Save this as a fact?". **Save** adds it to About your business as a verified fact; **No thanks** and Kabsi never asks about it again. Reviews are never used as facts.

**Will replies sound robotic?**
Drafts are two to four short sentences, mention something the customer actually said, and use your sign-off and tone (Warm, Formal or Short & friendly). Kabsi also looks at your last five approved replies to match how you write, and stops a draft that uses stock phrases such as "thrilled to hear" or that is too close to a reply you already posted. Drafts have no exclamation marks.

**Can replies make things up?**
Drafts use only the Verified facts in About your business. A missing fact is left out, never guessed. A suggestion you have not confirmed, a fact that is out of date, or a fact with two different answers is left out too. If a reviewer asks about a person who is not in your facts (for example "Is Maria still working there?"), the draft does not say either way. Kabsi checks every name, price, opening time and service in a draft against your facts before you see it.

**Will a reply offer discounts or refunds?**
No. Drafts never offer discounts, refunds, vouchers, free items or compensation, and a code check blocks drafts that do.

**Will a reply admit fault?**
No. Drafts don't admit fault or liability and never argue.

**Can I stop Kabsi saying certain things?**
Yes. List them under "Anything Kabsi should never say or promise" in About your business. Drafts, posts and the safety check follow it.

**Can replies mention my staff?**
Only names you add to the staff list, and only when the customer mentioned them.

**Can someone trick the AI with a fake review?**
Review text is treated as data, never instructions. Kabsi ignores commands inside a review and answers only the real content.

**Which languages does Kabsi reply in?**
The reviewer's language: English, Spanish, Arabic, French and many others.

**What about Franco-Arabic?**
Arabic written in Latin letters gets a simple English reply, because model-written Franco reads badly in public.

**Is the app in other languages?**
Not yet. The app and website are in English. Reply drafts are in each reviewer's language.

**Does Kabsi use my data to train AI?**
No. Google data is never used to train AI, and Anthropic, which drafts the replies, does not train on it.

### Honest answers to common objections

**Will Kabsi get me more reviews?**
We don't promise that, and nobody honest can. Kabsi makes leaving a review one tap or scan for every customer, and it makes sure every review gets a reply.

**Will Kabsi improve my rating?**
No one can promise a rating. Kabsi helps you answer every review calmly and keep your details accurate.

**Will Kabsi improve my Google ranking?**
Every job Kabsi does is on Google's own list of ways to improve local ranking. Nobody can promise a ranking, and we don't. Google ranks by relevance, distance and prominence, and Kabsi does the parts you control.

**Is this local SEO?**
Kabsi takes care of the parts of your profile you control: accurate details, answered reviews, regular posts, correct hours. It doesn't promise search results.

**Why not just reply myself?**
You can. Kabsi saves the writing, drafts in the customer's language, catches every review and gives you a calm draft for hard ones. You still decide every word.

**Is this allowed by Google?**
Adding a Manager is Google's own way to give a service access, and Kabsi uses Google's official Business Profile APIs. It posts only what you approve and never filters or rewards reviewers.

**Isn't Pro expensive?**
It's $19 a month, or $190 a year, and you can cancel a monthly plan any time. You can also start with a 14-day free trial with no card, so you see the drafts before you pay.

**What if I pay and Google access takes time?**
Your plan starts only when access works, so waiting costs you nothing.

**Is there a free trial?**
Yes. 14 days, no card. It starts when Kabsi's access to your Google profile works, and there is one trial per Google business. The review link tool is free, and a yearly plan is refundable in full within 14 days of the plan starting.

**Can I try it before paying?**
You can try the example inbox on the home page and finish setup before paying. Your plan starts only when payment is confirmed and Google access works.

**Do you have customer reviews or case studies?**
We don't publish testimonials or numbers we can't back up. Kabsi is new, and we'd rather you judge it yourself with the 14-day refund.

### Access and control

**Do I have to give you my Google password?**
Never. You add the Kabsi group ID 5481006796 as a Manager. Kabsi never asks for your password.

**Why Manager and not Owner?**
A Manager can reply, post and edit details, which is all Kabsi needs. Only owners can add or remove people or remove the profile, so you stay in control.

**Can I remove Kabsi's access?**
Yes, any time, without asking us. In Kabsi: **Settings**, **Disconnect Kabsi**, then **Disconnect** to confirm. Or on Google: Business Profile settings, People and access, select Kabsi Clients (group ID 5481006796), Remove person.

**What happens when I disconnect Kabsi in Settings?**
Only the owner can do it, signed in. Kabsi stops at once: no new drafts, no review emails, nothing more sent to Google. Approvals still waiting are cancelled, open review tasks are closed, and email links stop working. Kabsi then removes its own Manager access from your Google profile and emails you a confirmation with how to check it under People and access. If Google does not let Kabsi remove itself, Kabsi emails you that a person on the team removes it by a date at most 7 business days after your request, and you can also remove it yourself under People and access. Your ownership of the profile, your reviews on Google and your review link and cards are not affected; the cards keep working until your plan ends. The Google data Kabsi kept is deleted 30 days after access ends. To use Kabsi again afterwards, email hello@kabsi.co. Demo businesses cannot be disconnected.

**What happens if I remove Kabsi?**
Kabsi stops reading and posting at once and emails you once a day with the steps to reconnect. If access stays removed for 30 days, your Google data is deleted automatically.

**Does Kabsi change my profile without asking?**
No. Every change needs your approval of the exact content.

**Can Kabsi change my regular opening hours?**
No. Kabsi sets special hours for holidays and closures. Change regular hours on your Google profile.

### Posts, photos and hours

**What are Kabsi's posts?**
Short Google posts of three kinds: an Update, an Offer (with its start and end dates and terms, and an optional code and redeem link) or an Event (with its title, dates and times). Each can have one of your own checked photos and one button. Kabsi plans 2 a month by default (you can choose 1 or 4) and prepares them only from what is true: your confirmed facts and photos you approved. Offers and events are only the ones you type in; Kabsi never invents an offer, price, event, service, policy, staff member or hours. When it has nothing true to say, it asks one question instead: "Anything new this month? A dish, a service, an event?" Nothing is posted until you approve it, and you can switch Kabsi's own posts off.

**When do posts go to Google?**
Each post has its day and time: shops and restaurants on Thursday at 09:00, clinics and offices on Tuesday at 08:30, local time, in the first and third week (or the first week, or every week). Approve the month or each post; Kabsi keeps the approved post in its own queue and sends it at its time, and you can undo it until then. Kabsi checks once a day what the month still needs. Until Kabsi's AI credit is on, Kabsi does not write the posts itself: it asks you the one question, and you write the post on the Posts page.

**Can I turn off Kabsi's posts?**
Yes. On the Posts page, under Kabsi's posts, tap Turn off. Your own posts still work. You can also choose 1, 2 or 4 posts a month there.

**Can I write my own post?**
Yes. On Posts, under Write a post, choose Update, Offer or Event, write it in your words, add a photo and a button if you like, and tap Save the post. Kabsi checks it, then you approve it in its month.

**Which buttons can a post have?**
Call now, Book, Order online, Shop, Learn more or Sign up, or no button. These are the buttons Google offers.

**Do posts help my ranking?**
Posts keep customers informed. Google doesn't say they change ranking, so we don't either.

**Will posts mention prices or sales?**
Only what you tell Kabsi. It never invents prices, offers or dates.

**What does "Suggest phrases" do?**
It suggests words customers use for businesses like yours: your category and area, the services you listed, and (once connected) search terms Google reports for your profile. The button returns when Kabsi writes posts for you, once its AI credit is on.

**What photos can I post?**
Clear, real photos of your place, your team, your work and what you sell. Kabsi's check flags dark, blurry and small photos (under 720 by 720 pixels) and photos you already added. Kabsi removes the location data and other hidden details from every photo before it goes to Google.

**Can I set holiday hours?**
Yes. On Hours, choose the dates, Closed or different hours, review what Google will show, and tap Confirm and save to Google. Kabsi sends them to Google within a few minutes.

### Google Protection

**What is Google Protection?**
Kabsi watches your business name, phone, website, address, opening hours, main category, open status (open, temporarily closed, permanently closed) and map pin, and compares them with the details you confirmed. When Google shows something different, you get one email that explains it, for example "Google shows Sunday closing at 18:00. You approved 22:00.", and says whether Google made the change itself or Kabsi does not know who did. In the app you choose: "Google is right" (Google's value becomes your approved detail and nothing is sent to Google) or "Keep my information" (Kabsi sends your approved value back to Google, then checks Google shows it). Nothing changes on Google unless you say so, and Kabsi never puts anything back by itself. A change waiting for the owner appears as a card on Home.

**Can Google Protection lock my listing?**
No. Nobody can lock a Google listing or stop people suggesting edits. Kabsi tells you fast and puts your version back only if you say so.

**How fast will I hear about a change?**
Kabsi checks about once an hour once connected, and emails you when a detail changes.

**What if the change was mine?**
Tap "Google is right". Google's value becomes your approved version.

**Why does Kabsi sometimes recommend "Google is right"?**
Google removes things from business names that break its naming rules: a web address, a city or area, a slogan or extra keywords. When that is what Google removed (for example "Yawmiyati.com" to "Yawmiyati"), Kabsi recommends "Google is right" and says why: business names on Google can't include them, and putting them back can lead to a suspension. "Keep my information" is still there, with that warning.

**Why do I have to sign in for some changes?**
Your business name, address, main category, open status and map pin can make Google ask you to verify your business again when they change. Kabsi asks you to sign in to choose these (an email link alone is not enough; the email page asks you to sign in and brings you back), only the owner can choose, and the app says "Changing this can make Google ask you to verify your business again." Kabsi also sends at most one of these details back to Google at a time, at least 7 days apart; a second one inside the 7 days waits, and the app says the date it can go.

**What if Google keeps changing the same detail?**
Kabsi puts the same detail back at most twice in 30 days. If Google changes it a third time, Kabsi does not send it again: a person on the Kabsi team contacts Google Business Profile support for you, with an explanation ready.

**What does "Replaced by a newer change" or "No answer in 14 days" mean?**
"Replaced by a newer change": Google changed the same detail again before you chose, so Kabsi shows you the newest change instead; nothing was decided for you. "No answer in 14 days": nobody chose within 14 days, so the change is closed without a decision and Kabsi does not email about that same value again. Nothing was put back or kept for you in either case.

**Which details count as approved by me?**
Only details you confirmed yourself in Kabsi, or where you chose "Google is right". Values Kabsi read from Google are "Not yet confirmed by you" until you confirm them: Kabsi still watches them and tells you when they change, but never offers to put an unconfirmed value back. Everything you saved in About your business counts as confirmed by you.

### Review links and cards

**Do I need an NFC card?**
No. Every business gets a review link and a printable QR code. They work with your own QR codes and NFC cards, so a card is optional.

**What does an NFC card do?**
Tapping a card that carries your review link opens your Google review page, the same page for every customer.

**Does Kabsi sell NFC cards?**
No, not anywhere. Use your free review link and QR code, or a blank NFC card you write yourself (section 5.4).

**Is the price different in some countries?**
No. The price is the same everywhere, in US dollars. Kabsi Pro is software only.

**Which NFC card should I buy?**
Any blank NFC card or sticker with an NTAG213 or NTAG215 chip works.

**How do I put my link on an NFC card?**
Copy your review link from Get reviews, open a free NFC writer app such as NFC Tools, write it as a URL record, and test it with a phone (section 5.4).

**Does the card work with iPhone and Android?**
Yes, by tap or by scan.

**Does the card ask only happy customers?**
No. Every tap and scan opens your Google review page. There's no rating screen before it.

**Do taps mean reviews?**
No. Taps and scans count how often your review page was opened, not whether a review was written.

**Does Kabsi know who tapped?**
No. It records the time, country, phone type and tap or scan, never who you are or your IP address.

**Can I offer a discount for reviews?**
No. Google doesn't allow rewards for reviews and can remove those reviews.

**How many review links can I have?**
Up to 5 per business, so you can use one per spot and compare opens.

**Can I switch a card or link off?**
Yes, on the Get reviews page. It can take up to a minute on phones.

**Can I put a card on a metal surface?**
No. NFC doesn't work through metal.

### Pricing and payment

**How much is Kabsi?**
Kabsi Pro is $19 a month or $190 a year, with a 14-day free trial and no card. Extra locations are $15 a month or $150 a year. There is also a free plan with your review link and QR code.

**Is there a free trial?**
Yes. 14 days, no card. It starts when Kabsi's access to your Google profile works.

**Is there a free plan?**
Yes. Free is your review link, a QR code, a printable table card and a message to share. It keeps working for as long as Kabsi operates.

**Are prices the same in every country?**
Yes, in US dollars.

**Is there a monthly plan?**
Yes. Kabsi Pro is $19 a month, and you can cancel any time. The yearly plan is $190 a year, two months free.

**How do I pay?**
By card, in US dollars. Card payments are coming; until they open there is nothing to pay, and the trial needs no card.

**Can I pay with crypto, cash or a bank transfer?**
No. Card payments in US dollars are the only way to pay Kabsi.

**Does my plan renew automatically?**
Kabsi never charges on its own today. How renewals work with card payments will be on the pricing page when card payments open. Monthly plans can be cancelled at any time.

**When does my plan start?**
When payment is confirmed and Kabsi's Google access works. Waiting for access doesn't count.

**What happens when my plan ends?**
Reviews, Google Profile, Google Protection and the Weekly Care Report stop. Get Reviews keeps working: your review link and QR code still open your Google review page.

**Can I get a refund?**
Yearly plans are refundable in full within 14 days of the plan starting.

**Do you offer discounts?**
No discounts are listed. For anything special, email hello@kabsi.co.

### Businesses, locations and agencies

**Can I use Kabsi for more than one location?**
Yes. Each location is its own business in Kabsi, with its own Google profile, reviews, plan and review link. Switch between them in the header.

**Is there a multi-location price?**
One plan covers one Google profile. For volume pricing, email hello@kabsi.co.

**Can my team use Kabsi?**
Up to 3 extra addresses can receive review emails. Only the business's members can post. For other access needs, email hello@kabsi.co.

**I'm an agency. Can I use Kabsi for my clients?**
Yes: each client signs up for their own business and invites you as a Manager in Team. You then work in their Kabsi with the rights they give you. There is no reselling. Kabsi Partners, an affiliate program, is coming and not open yet.

**Can an agency post replies for its clients?**
Only as a Manager the owner invited, and only for what the owner allows. Changes to the business name, address, main category or open status, and reviews that need more care, always need the owner.

**Is there a white-label version?**
No. White-label isn't available.

**Does Kabsi work in my country?**
Yes. Signup is open in every country, prices are the same, and drafts follow each reviewer's language.

**Does Kabsi work with Yelp, TripAdvisor, Facebook or booking sites?**
No. Kabsi works with your Google Business Profile only.

**Does Kabsi answer Google Q&A?**
No. Google removed Q&A from Business Profiles in November 2025. Put common questions in About your business and Kabsi uses them in replies and posts.

### Reviews on Google

**Can Kabsi remove bad reviews?**
No. Nobody outside Google can remove a review. Kabsi helps you answer every review calmly. You can report reviews that break Google's rules to Google.

**How do I report a fake review?**
On your Business Profile, Read reviews, the Report icon next to the review, choose the reason, Send report. Or use Google's Reviews Management Tool (section 8.4).

**How long does Google take to decide on a report?**
Usually several days. If the review stays up, you can appeal once.

**Someone offered to remove my bad reviews for a fee. Should I pay?**
Nobody outside Google can remove a review. Report reviews that break Google's rules yourself, for free.

**Should I reply to every review?**
Google says helpful replies show you're responsive, and readers see that you listen. Kabsi makes it easy by drafting every reply.

**How long does Google take to show my reply?**
Google checks each reply first, usually within 10 minutes, sometimes longer.

**Can I edit a reply after posting?**
Yes, on your Google profile. Google lets you edit or delete your reply later.

### Data and privacy

**Is my Google data sold?**
No. It's never sold or rented and never used for advertising or to train AI models.

**How long do you keep review text?**
At most 30 days after Google last sent it, as Google's rules require. Ratings, dates and your replies stay.

**Where is my data stored?**
The database is with Supabase in Frankfurt, Germany. Other providers are listed in the privacy policy.

**Can partners see my reviews?**
No. Nobody outside your team sees your business in Kabsi. Someone you invite to your team sees only what their role allows.

**Is the dashboard recorded?**
No. Screen recordings happen only on public web pages, never inside the app.

**How do I delete my data?**
Settings, Delete this business, type the name, Delete in 7 days. Or email hello@kabsi.co from your account email. Also remove the Kabsi Clients group (ID 5481006796) from People and access.

**What happens to my cards if I delete my business?**
Review links and QR codes stop working, and so does any NFC card that carries them.

### Account

**How do I log in?**
Enter your email and type the 6-digit code we send. No password.

**Why a code and not a link?**
A link would log in on whatever device opens the email. A code keeps sign-in on the device you're using.

**Can I change my account email?**
Email hello@kabsi.co from your current address and a person will help.

**Can I close my account?**
Delete your business in Settings, and ask by email to delete your login too.

---

## 12. Glossary

- **Google Business Profile:** your business's listing on Google Search and Maps.
- **Manager / Owner:** Google profile roles. A Manager can reply, post and edit details; only an Owner can add or remove people or remove the profile. Kabsi is a Manager.
- **People and access:** the Google screen where owners add or remove Managers.
- **hello@kabsi.co:** Kabsi's support email. **5481006796:** Kabsi's Google business group ID (Kabsi Clients), invited as Manager.
- **Reviews:** one screen for every review. Filters: Needs reply, All, Replied, Positive (4 and 5 stars), Neutral (3), Negative (1 and 2) and High risk. Each review shows its stars, text, date, name, risk and one status: Draft ready, Waiting for you, Published, Google is checking your reply, Rejected by Google, or You chose not to reply. On a phone one review fills the screen with **Approve reply** as the large button, then **Edit** and **Other options** (Shorter, More formal, Warmer, Regenerate, I'll reply myself, Skip). An owner can approve; a manager only for what the owner turned on; staff do not see reviews. The older address for "To reply" opens Reviews, Needs reply.
- **Risk level:** low, medium or high, set for each review. Medium shows the issue above the draft. High risk: no draft, a short checklist, and a neutral holding reply only if the owner asks for one.
- **You replied yourself:** a review you chose to answer on Google yourself. Kabsi posts nothing.
- **Daily email:** one email a day that groups what came up since the last one: reviews that came in outside your opening hours with their drafts, profile changes, posts and photos to approve.
- **About your business:** the facts Kabsi may use in drafts.
- **Never-say list:** "Anything Kabsi should never say or promise".
- **Safety check:** the automatic check of each draft against Kabsi's rules and your never-say list.
- **Kabsi's posts:** the posts Kabsi prepares each month (2 by default, 1 or 4 by choice) for your approval.
- **Search phrases:** words people use to search for a business like yours, worked into a post's first line. They come from your category, your area and the services you listed in About your business, and, once Kabsi is connected to Google live, from Google's own search terms. Never from your reviews.
- **Special hours:** hours for specific dates, like holidays.
- **Google Protection:** watches key listing details, alerts you and lets you choose in the app whether to keep your information.
- **Profile health:** the suggestions list on Home, no score.
- **Review link:** go.kabsi.co/{CODE}, opens your Google review page, or a short Kabsi page with the Google button first if you chose that. Up to 5 per business.
- **NTAG213 / NTAG215:** common NFC chip types that work for review links.
- **NFC Tools:** a free app for writing a link onto an NFC tag.
- **Tap / open:** one opening of your review page. Not a review.
- **Card code:** the 6-character code under a Kabsi card's QR.
- **Test mode:** [TIME-SENSITIVE] Kabsi's state until Google approves its API access. Nothing is sent to Google automatically.
- **Early access:** [TIME-SENSITIVE] a person on the Kabsi team does the Google steps by hand and posts what the owner approves, within one working day.
- **Free:** the plan with the review link, QR code and table card. Also what a business is on after a trial or plan ends. **[CHANGING]** There will be no Free plan with Essentials and Pro.
- **Free trial:** 14 days, no card, starting when Google access works.
- **Kabsi Clients (5481006796):** Kabsi's Google business group. Owners invite it as a Manager.
- **Waiting for Google access:** Kabsi's Manager access doesn't work yet for that business.
- **Kabsi Partners:** [COMING] Kabsi's affiliate program (section 6). Not open yet.
- **Place ID:** Google's identifier for a business on Maps, used to build its review link.

---

## 13. Hand-off list

The assistant must not answer these. Say you'll pass it to the Kabsi team and give hello@kabsi.co (a person answers).

**Money**
- Refund requests, billing disputes, chargebacks, wrong amounts sent, payments sent to a wrong address or network.
- "Has my payment been confirmed?" when the system doesn't show it.
- Invoices, receipts, VAT or tax documents, company details on invoices.
- Discounts, coupons, free trials, custom or volume pricing, multi-location deals.
- Payment methods not listed (credit card, bank transfer, PayPal, other coins or networks).

**Accounts and access**
- Lost access to the account email, changing the account email, transferring a business to another owner or account.
- Adding people who can approve or post for a business.
- A business stuck on "Waiting for Google access" after Kabsi is live.
- Google account problems: suspended, unverified or duplicate listings, ownership disputes.

**Google**
- Any date for Google's API approval or go-live.
- Specific review removal cases, suspected fake review campaigns, Google policy disputes.
- Google Protection "Google did not take your information" that the owner can't fix on Google.

**Cards**
- A Kabsi card someone already has that does not work (after the steps in section 10).

**Partners**
- Questions about Kabsi Partners, custom terms, commission ideas, white-label or reselling: none exist today.

**Legal, privacy and safety**
- Privacy or data requests (access, copy, correction, objection, deletion of a login).
- Legal notices, law enforcement requests, court orders, defamation claims.
- A reviewer asking about their own review or data.
- Health privacy law questions (HIPAA and similar) beyond the general note in 7.3.
- Security vulnerability reports.
- Terms and privacy interpretation for a specific case.

**Product**
- Integrations and APIs (booking systems, POS, CRM, other review sites), and features not described here.
- Bugs, errors or anything that behaves differently from this document.
- Requests to change how drafts are written beyond About your business.
- Roadmap questions (more site languages, other notification channels, new features).

**People**
- Angry, upset or threatening customers (after one calm reply).
- Press, investors, jobs and partnerships other than the partner program.
- Anything not in this knowledge base.
